title: Buzhongyiqi granules in ulcerative colitis Therapy: Integrated chemical composition, pharmacodynamic validation, and IL-6/STAT3 axis regulation.
authors: Zhou, Yinwei; Wang, Wenbo; Gu, Han; Jiang, Ying; Wang, Xi; Su, Xin; Shao, Zhixiang; An, Kang; Liang, Rui; Ma, Yuzhen; Wang, Rui; Luo, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦中药补中益气颗粒治疗溃疡性结肠炎，涉及IL-6/STAT3通路与分子对接，但核心是中药药理与免疫机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Buzhongyiqi Granules (BZYQ), a classical herbal formulation derived from Pi Wei Lun, is traditionally used to regulate Qi and blood circulation while enhancing immune function, particularly for gastrointestinal disorders. However, its protective effects and mechanisms on ulcerative colitis (UC) remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to identify the blood-entering bioactive components of BZYQ and elucidate its immune-modulatory mechanisms in UC using an integrated strategy combining medicinal chemistry, bioinformatics analysis, molecular docking, and experimental validation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical profile and serum pharmacochemistry components (SPCs) of BZYQ were identified via UPLC-QE-Orbitrap mass spectrometry. Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted UC-related targets and pathways. In vivo, experimental colitis was induced via 3 % dextran sulfate sodium solution administration for 7 days, followed by 10-day BZYQ treatment. Anti-inflammatory effects were validated through flow cytometry, qPCR, Western blotting, and in vitro bone marrow-derived macrophage (BMDM) cultures. RESULTS: Fifty-four compounds were identified in BZYQ, with seven SPCs (astragaloside IV, licoflavone A, 18beta-glycyrrhizinic acid, glabrolide, ganoderic acid X, complanatuside, and isosakuranin) directly related to UC pathogenesis. Molecular docking confirmed high-affinity interactions between glabrolide and IL-6. BZYQ alleviated colitis by suppressing IL-6/STAT3 axis, reprogramming macrophage polarization, increasing regulatory T cell frequency, and suppressing naive CD4(+) T cell differentiation. CONCLUSIONS: This study is the first to define BZYQ's component basis and cellular immunological mechanisms in UC alleviation. These findings contribute to the development and application of traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：补中益气颗粒（BZYQ）是一种源自《脾胃论》的经典中药复方，传统上用于调节气血循环并增强免疫功能，尤其适用于胃肠道疾病。然而，其对溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的保护作用及机制尚不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在通过整合药物化学、生物信息学分析、分子对接和实验验证的策略，鉴定BZYQ的血中移行生物活性成分，并阐明其在UC中的免疫调节机制。材料与方法：通过UPLC-QE-Orbitrap质谱法鉴定了BZYQ的化学谱和血清药物化学组分（SPCs）。网络药理学和分子对接预测了UC相关靶点和通路。在体内实验中，通过给予3%葡聚糖硫酸钠溶液7天诱导实验性结肠炎，随后进行10天BZYQ治疗。通过流式细胞术、qPCR、Western blotting及体外骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）培养验证了抗炎效应。结果：在BZYQ中鉴定出54种化合物，其中7种SPCs（黄芪甲苷IV、甘草黄酮A、18β-甘草次酸、甘草内酯、灵芝酸X、沙苑子苷和异樱花素）与UC发病机制直接相关。分子对接证实了甘草内酯与IL-6之间的高亲和力相互作用。BZYQ通过抑制IL-6/STAT3轴、重编程巨噬细胞极化、增加调节性T细胞频率及抑制初始CD4(+) T细胞分化来缓解结肠炎。结论：本研究首次明确了BZYQ在缓解UC中的成分基础及细胞免疫学机制。这些发现有助于中药处方的开发与应用。
